semiconductor_relevance: High — IVT Tech Co., Ltd is directly involved in the production of CMP consumables, which are critical in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: IVT Tech Co., Ltd specializes in the production of Chemical Mechanical Planarization (CMP) consumables, including polishing pads for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products are designed for high performance in polishing speed, defect reduction, and stability, applicable to various materials like Oxide, Tungsten, Copper, and Polyimide.
capabilities: HV and GV series CMP polishing pads
Soft Pad polishing pads (JK and JOHO series)
Customization of CMP pads based on material properties and groove designs
CMP consumables for Oxide, Tungsten, Copper, and Polyimide processes
